turns.question: Which ad channel had the lowest cost per lead between 17 August and 2 October 2026, and what was that cost in EUR?
turns.answer: Email had the lowest cost per lead, at about 33.57 EUR per lead, between 17 August and 2 October 2026 (search was 43.25 EUR, social 52.22 EUR). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
